heroTitle: UV Printing: Direct Printing on Glass, Wood, Metal and Acrylic
description: Direct UV printing on glass, metal, wood, acrylic and composite with a 4x2 m flatbed press. Produced in our own facility in Istanbul, cutting and installation included.
heroDesc: At our facility in Pendik, Istanbul we print directly onto glass, metal, wood, acrylic, composite, PVC foam board and rigid PVC on a 4x2 m SwissQprint UV flatbed press. White underbase and varnish layers, laser and CNC cutting, and on-site installation where needed all happen under one roof. We handle everything from a single sample to production runs of a thousand pieces.

facility.title: UV Printing Happens in Our Own Facility
facility.description: We do not outsource UV printing. Our 4x2 m UV flatbed press, laser and PVC cutting line and laminating machine are all in our production facility in Pendik, Istanbul, so every step from printing to cutting is done by our own team. That is how we keep control of colour, lead time and cost — and how urgent jobs can go into production the same day.

faq.q: Which materials can you print on?
faq.a: Any rigid surface up to 10 cm thick: glass, mirror, acrylic, aluminium, composite, MDF, solid wood, PVC foam board, rigid PVC, laminate and leather. If you are unsure about a material, send us a sample and we will test it.

faq.q: Can you print white on transparent or dark material?
faq.a: Yes. Our press prints CMYK plus white, so we lay a white underbase under the colours on glass, acrylic and dark surfaces.
No. We print a single piece as readily as a production run, because a flatbed press needs no plates or screens.

faq.q: Can I supply my own material?
faq.a: Yes. If you bring your own sheets you pay only for the printing. If we supply the material, the sheet cost is added to the quote.

faq.q: How do you match a specific colour?
faq.a: We match to your Pantone reference or to a physical sample. For colour-critical work we recommend a test print before the run.
Standard work is delivered within a few working days of artwork approval. Urgent jobs can be scheduled for same-day or next-day production.

fiyatFaktorleri.aciklama: Glass, acrylic, MDF, composite, PVC foam board, metal. If we supply the material, the sheet cost is added; if you bring your own, you pay for the printing only.
Pricing is calculated per square metre. The unit price falls as quantity rises, because machine set-up is spread across more pieces.
On clear glass and dark surfaces, a white underbase, raised varnish or spot gloss each adds a layer — and every layer adds press time.
Straight cutting is standard. Contour cutting by laser or CNC, drilling, rounded corners and mounting hardware are quoted separately.
There is no design charge if you send print-ready vector artwork. Design or retouching is charged by the time it takes.
Standard lead times get our best price. Same-day work and jobs needing a night shift are planned and quoted separately.

bolge.baslik: From Pendik Across Istanbul and Beyond
bolge.metin: Our production facility is in Pendik, on the Asian side of Istanbul. For work anywhere in Istanbul we survey the site ourselves, print in our own facility and install with our own team. We ship packed goods to the European side and to the rest of Turkey, and we handle export shipments on request.
